Combine above-ground first-floor area with total basement area to approximate overall usable floor area, a strong driver of house price and highly correlated components in the EDA.
OverallQual and GrLivArea are among the strongest price drivers; a multiplicative term captures the joint effect of size and quality that linear terms alone may miss.
Aggregate full and half bathrooms into a single above-grade bath count, a commonly useful amenity signal that correlates with price.
YearBuilt has 106 distinct values and non-linear age effects; quantile binning creates stable ordinal era groupings that models can exploit without overfitting rare years.
Neighborhood has 25 levels with many sparse categories; grouping rare levels reduces cardinality and noise ahead of downstream encoding in modeling.
